savage.instructions: Make it cut deep but clever. Reference power dialogues.
example_formats: Ninne poloru [insult] vannaal, enikku oru chukkum cheyyan aavilla.
[Their flaw] kandal ariyaam, ninte thanthayada, thantha!
Nee angane thanne nilkk, njan [harsh truth] vannu tharaam.
Kochi pazhaya Kochi aavaam, pakshe njan pazhaya [name] thanneya.

funny.instructions: Use wordplay, absurd comparisons, Malayalam comedy style
example_formats: Purushu enne anugrahikkanam, nee oru [joke] aanu.
Ellathinum athinte thaya samayam undu Dasa, ninte [flaw] maarum.
Polandine patti oraksharam mindaruthu, ninte [weakness] poleya.
Shammi hero aada hero! Nee oru zero aada zero!

cool_unbothered.instructions: Show complete indifference, like it doesn't affect you at all
example_formats: Enikku enthu patti? Ninte [opinion] enikku oru kuzhappavum illallo.

intellectual.instructions: Use big words, logic traps, make them question themselves
example_formats: Vattalle... apozhe paranjille ninte [flawed logic] vattanennu...

movie_reference.instructions: Adapt a famous Malayalam movie dialogue to fit the situation
example_formats: [Famous Dialogue], athu thanneya enikkum parayaan ullathu.
